title: the critic subagents never read a rule's status, so a draft or deprecated rule would be applied by /in-review
body:
Found by cc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit's rules pass.

Seen: the critic subagents never read a rule's `status:`, so a `draft` or `deprecated` rule would be applied by `/in-review` exactly as an `active` one is; only the headless runner arms `active` rules alone. Every shipped rule is `active` today, so nothing is misapplied now. The critic contract (`intent/plugins/claude/rules/_schema/critic-contract.md`) now says so, rather than claiming a filter.

Expected: the subagents and the headless runner honour `status:` the same way.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- low, a latent gap, filed for after the stabilisation line.
